texts.preamble: Deepu Sharma vs State Of Punjab And Others on 23 January, 2026 101 In The High Court Of Punjab And Haryana At Chandigarh Cm-19591-Cwp-2025 & Cm-19592-Cwp-2025 In/And Cwp-10618-2022 Date of Decision: 23Rd January 2026 Deepu Sharma .......Petitioner(s) V/s. State Of Punjab And Others ......Respondent(s) Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Ashwani Kumar Mishra Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Kuldeep Tiwari Present Mr. Neeraj Jain, Advocate, for the applicant-petitioner. Ms. Samdisha Kaur, Aag, Punjab. * * ** Ashwani Kumar Mishra, J. (Oral) Cm-19591-Cwp-2025
texts.facts: Delay of 112 days in filing of the application has been satisfactorily explained. Accordingly, application is allowed and delay of 112 days in filing the application is condoned. CM-19592-CWP-2025 This application is filed for restoration of main Writ Petition i.e. CWP-10618-2022 which was dismissed for non-prosecution by this Court vide order dated 01.08.2025. Sufficient cause has been shown for non-appearance on behalf of the counsel for the petitioner. The petitioner claims to be a Street Vendor. It is submitted that he has appropriate licence/certificate from the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India, yet the Municipal Corporation, Bhatinda and its officials are not allowing the petitioner to work as a Street Vendor. Provisions of the Street Vendors (Protection of Livelihood and Regulation of Street Vending) 1 of 2 CWP-10618-2022 (O&M) Act, 2014 (hereinafter referred to as "the Act of 2014") have been relied upon in order to submit that the petitioner cannot be forcibly removed. 2. This petition was filed in the year 2022 and till date, notice in this petition has not been issued. The petition was dismissed twice for non-prosecution by this Court.
